title: React Native - Mobile Development Made Simple • All Things Open 2025
content:
This talk covers how React Native, paired with Expo and the latest 2025 tools, makes building mobile apps faster and more accessible than ever. We’ll explore new EAS updates for easier builds and app submissions, and how AI tools like Bolt are streamlining development. Whether you’re a beginner or scaling a team, learn why React Native is still the easiest way to build high-quality cross-platform mobile apps.
